prior_year_events.impact_description: impact of Covid-19 through exposure to reinsurance of business interruption insurance, offsetting prior year catastrophe reserve releases

named_events.loss_description: impact of Covid-19, totalling $20.4 million, net of reinsurance, through exposure to reinsurance of business interruption insurance.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $1.682 million in 2020. This movement was influenced by mixed factors, with prior year catastrophe reserve releases, particularly from Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis (2019), being offset by adverse development related to COVID-19 impacts, specifically from business interruption insurance exposures, resulting in a net gross strengthening.
data.data_quality_notes: The narrative on page 41 states 'prior year catastrophe reserve releases' implying a net release, but the gross technical provisions table on page 53 shows a gross strengthening of $1.682 million. The gross figure from the technical provisions table is used for prior_year_development_gbp_m. The claims development triangle on page 55 indicates a gross release of $6.319 million, which contradicts the direct statement in the technical provisions note. The direct statement is prioritized.
